name: Ashford Castle
insider_take: This 800-year-old medieval castle turned luxury hotel sits majestically on the shores of Lough Corrib, where Irish nobility and Hollywood royalty have found their perfect escape.
whats_special: Built in 1228, Ashford Castle spans 350 acres of pristine Irish countryside and features its own falconry school - one of Ireland's oldest field sports. The castle has hosted presidents, movie stars, and even served as the filming location for "The Quiet Man" starring John Wayne and Maureen O'Hara. Each room is uniquely decorated with antiques and period furnishings, making every stay a journey through centuries of Irish heritage.
pro_tip: Book the falconry experience during golden hour for breathtaking photos with birds of prey against the castle's medieval towers and Lough Corrib's shimmering waters.
dont_miss: The castle's award-winning spa treatments in the underground wine cellar, clay pigeon shooting on the estate grounds, and a sunset cruise on Lough Corrib aboard the hotel's vintage wooden boat. The nearby village of Cong offers charming Irish pubs and is home to the Quiet Man Museum celebrating the classic film's legacy.
pros: Exceptional luxury amenities including spa and fine dining
Stunning lakefront location on Lough Corrib
World-class activities including falconry and golf
